newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: The crown lost some of Wednesday's strength on Thursday and bond yields rose in a correction and line with weaker foreign markets, but traders said markets were more driven by overseas than domestic factors.

The mark firmed against the dollar and on crosses after Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said dollar-mark strengthening had come to an end: "The weakening of the crown is mostly due to Tietmeyer's comments but a recoil has been in the air as well after yesterday's gains," one forex dealer said.
"Nothing has happened, really. We followed German yields and Italy has seen yields come back up", a bond dealer said.
